name: proton-mail
description: Read-only Proton Mail access via Proton Bridge IMAP (list/search/read). Requires Proton Bridge running locally with IMAP enabled. Does not send or draft mail.

PROTON_BRIDGE_USER.description: Proton Bridge IMAP username (usually your Proton Mail address)

PROTON_BRIDGE_PASSWORD.description: Proton Bridge IMAP password (Bridge-generated, not your Proton account password)

com.tinkabot.proton-mail.note: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 has no top-level variables field; Bridge secrets are declared here and documented in README / .env.example. Set them in the host environment before launching the MCP server.
